scope.description: CRT lane only:37 nonce/hash-bound closed receipt files;36 assigned/completed guarded Jobs plus1 pre-Job rejected launch receipt. All exact receipts report active_at_release0/no cleanup errors. Earlier failed/overlapping/native/protocol observations remain separate from qualification. Root confirmed no owned engine/browser/runtime remains and no more launches this slot. No global host/process census, unrelated tasks/watchers or protected-profile cleanup. Historical global inventory unchanged.
